svg.title: Commercial quotas: architecture layers
svg.desc: Provider capabilities enter Products through discovery and review. Pricing freezes quota and price terms. Orders and Subscriptions commit the purchase. Entitlements sends desired quotas through the selected adapter to OSS. Application evidence returns through the adapter to Entitlements and Subscriptions. OSS owns resource allocation, usage counters and releases.
svg.text: From provider capabilities to purchased limits and confirmed application
Desired quota set and application operation
